messages.body: ao centro do cartão, vamos colocar numero de progresso e status. vamos manter algo mais visual.

Done: each Cohort row now shows its run in the middle (new _chart/CohortRun.vue): a progress ring with the average % beside it, and the status as the app's badge (Starts… blue, Session N of 10 green, Finished grey; the ring takes the same colour). The faces column keeps a fixed width so rings and badges line up row to row. Data comes from the sample world's cohorts and is generated for Large district (district.ts).
